intro.title: Turn a request into structured requirements and demands
intro.body: Write the user's need in plain language. The assistant extracts requirements, flags ambiguities and contradictions, raises questions and proposes acceptance criteria for you to review before it becomes a demand for the agent team.
intro.stepsLabel: How to use the PO assistant
intro.step1: Describe the request in free text and attach supporting files if useful.
intro.step2: Click "Analyze request" to organize the content into panels.
intro.step3: Review each panel: edit, mark as resolved, or discard what does not apply.
intro.step4: Click "Create structured demand" — it goes to the board and to Bruna.
intro.note: The analysis is a support tool: review and adjust the panels before creating the demand.

noProject.body: Select or create a project to analyze solicitations with the PO assistant.
